plain_language.what_did_we_find: Provisional: all 24 focused tests pass. The revised auditor detects a consistently wrong named/index expectation, and live tests now use examples without scientific ordinals. Four earlier selected rows remain preserved as a preparation staging incident; no observer outcomes exist yet.
plain_language.is_it_interesting: Yes as assurance tooling: expected results follow separate named-variable and index-based calculations, and the checked corpus must match the exact files sent to observers. Passing these checks is not proof that either model or implementation is correct.
plain_language.does_it_require_more_work: Explicitly record unchanged adoption of the four prewritten rows, commit exact scientific/execution manifests, and obtain the final construction review. Actual-host RSS and a separate launch review remain required before observer execution.

findings.model: Capture avoidance uses free-name substitution, deterministic fresh binder renaming and shadow-aware traversal. Lifting changes the external context rather than recursively adjusting indices. Hand-written checks cover capture, target shadowing, nested same-name binders and let nonbody scope.
findings.auditor: Separate agent-owned auditor imports neither model nor producer. It independently translates names and directly calculates index operations. audit_vector first checks exact deterministic selection and invokes the same audit_operation exercised by synthetic positive/negative tests.
findings.negative_controls: Consistently wrong named+DB outputs and captured outputs reach E_EXPECTATION. Other tests cover binder-domain/let-value depth, higher-index lowering, lexical shadowing, bool/negative indices, missing/duplicate/extra/reordered ordinals and strict NDJSON.
findings.selection_and_alpha: Selection replay intentionally repeats the frozen construction algorithm; it is a custody check, not an independent diversity or correctness argument. Translation in the same ordered context canonicalizes alpha-equivalent names. Model and auditor share the chosen structural contract, so correlated contract errors remain possible.
findings.observations: Adapters call the exact selected operations and serialize full results without reading expected fields. Each composition emits intermediate/final stages. Reconciliation validates strict IDs/schema/row counts and preserves a wrong nonnegative index, including >32, as a distinguishing output.
findings.partition: Exact byte equality between each 500-row batch and the corresponding full-corpus partition is enforced during construction, sealing and launch. Altered/duplicate partition negatives pass.
findings.repairs: R1 snapshot and review remain unchanged. Live ordinal-free tests exercise the actual semantic auditor interface. Controller records failed construction and process invocation evidence; malformed JSON is converted into a gate error with cardinality-preserving negative coverage.
findings.remaining: No manifests have yet received final independent construction approval; the prewritten-row adoption and committed-input/RSS gates cannot be inferred from this tooling PASS.
